name: Håkan Karlsson Faronius
research: My research focuses on the mathematical foundations of neurosymbolic AI. I study the interaction between learning and reasoning using probabilistic circuits and Bayesian network representations, and investigate reasoning shortcuts in neurosymbolic systems.
I am also interested in uncertainty estimation in AI and the study of emergence in complex systems.

preprints.title: Independence Is Not an Issue in Neurosymbolic AI
preprints.authors: Håkan Karlsson Faronius, Pedro Zuidberg Dos Martires
preprints.description: An investigation of conditional independence and deterministic bias in neurosymbolic AI, examining whether the tendency to favor a single valid solution can be attributed to independence assumptions.

theses.title: Solving Partial Differential Equations With Neural Networks
theses.description: A study of physics-informed neural networks, Fourier neural operators, and the Deep Ritz method for solving partial differential equations and variational problems.

theses.title: On the Implementation of Computer Intensive Methods in Linear Normal Models
theses.description: Bayesian inference in linear normal models, with implementations of Markov chain Monte Carlo and approximate Bayesian computation in R.
